about: Shared components of the Orbit custom UI: one contract per component (props, states, events and keys, data, what it uses). Source of R12 · Component catalog and of the "Components on this board" sections on R06-R11 and the naming table on R03; built by tools/lc_components.py. Code paths are under public/app/orbit/. Edit this file, then run tools/build_all.sh.
title: Component catalog
intro: Every shared component of the custom UI, with its contract: props, states, events and keys, data, and what it uses. Each screen board drew its own copy of a component and its own behaviour; here they are merged into one component each, so agents can build them one by one and the prototype can put them together. Source: .orbit/design/components.json (the same data, for agents). Names follow R03; code paths follow ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.
fit: The shell is always on screen; overlays open from it one at a time; views fill the page inside the shell. Four hooks hold the shared state, so a click in one component changes the others: useActiveApp, useBookmarks, useApps, useOverlay.

groups.name: Shell
groups.lead: The frame around every page: top bar, breadcrumb, dock. Always on screen.

groups.name: Overlays
groups.lead: Opened from the shell; one at a time, on the shared glass surface.

groups.name: Shared parts
groups.lead: Small components used by several shell parts and views.

groups.name: Views
groups.lead: Pages of the Apps Manager and the bookmarks page, built from the parts.

groups.name: Shared state
groups.lead: Hooks that every component reads; they are what connects the components in one app.

groups.name: Data contracts
groups.lead: Data the UI reads, not UI.

groups.name: Page templates
groups.lead: Layouts that put Grafana content inside the shell.

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: Outer frame, shell and inner panel. Holds the TopBar, the breadcrumb row, the page content and the Dock, and the layer where overlays open.
parts: App accent marker (3x36 bar beside the breadcrumb)
props: activeApp: App, sets the accent tokens --hac --hbg --htx
overlay: OverlayId | null, which overlay is open (from useOverlay)
states: Overlay open: the page behind is blurred and dimmed (blur 4px, brightness .45) only while the MenuSheet is open
events: Route change → close any open overlay
open: Height: top bar 63 + breadcrumb 36 differs from Grafana's 40 or 48 header; anything that measures the header must be checked (R06)

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: Top row of the shell: logo, Clock, search trigger, AddMenu trigger and the UserAvatar that opens the UserMenu.
parts: Search trigger 230x36 with the key hint
states: UserMenu open (2px accent ring on the avatar)
events: Ctrl or Cmd + K opens search, as in Grafana
open: Help, page actions, extensions, invite, sign in and assistant have no place yet (OD5, R06)

components.name: Clock
components.summary: Date and time block in the TopBar for factory-floor screens.
states: Reduced motion: the colon does not blink

components.name: UserAvatar
components.summary: The current user's image; the first letters of first and last name when there is no image.
parts: Accent ring while the UserMenu is open
props: active: boolean, the menu is open
events: Enter or Space opens the UserMenu

components.name: AppBreadcrumb
components.summary: Chevron breadcrumb row: app chip, page, sub page. The caret on the last crumb lists its siblings.
events: Crumbs are links in tab order
Enter or Space on the caret or '...' opens its menu
open: Collapse threshold and which levels stay (R11, decision needed)

components.name: Dock
components.summary: Floating bar at the bottom: workspace button, fixed items, the active app's bookmarks, the add-bookmark slot and the Menu item.
parts: Workspace button (app tile, 'App', app name, caret)
Fixed items: Home, Dashboards, Bookmarks, Starred, Alerting
Bookmarks group of the active app (accent tokens --mac --mbg --mbd --mhv)
props: bookmarks: Bookmark[] of the active app with showInDock
selected: route of the current page
loading: boolean, while another app's pages load
states: Item hover or focus (tinted fill, 2px bar)
Add slot open ('+' turns into a close mark)
App without a logo: its initial in the tile instead of the icon
events: Fixed item or bookmark → navigates, closes any overlay
Esc while an overlay is open closes it and returns focus to the item that opened it (N8)
open: Which item is selected on a page that is not bookmarked (R07)
Overflow below desktop width; reorder; motion (R07)

components.name: MenuSheet
components.summary: Sheet above the dock: a rail with the active app's pages, the current page's sub pages as tiles, a header and a footer with key hints. Six screen boards each drew one state of it; this entry merges them.
parts: Rail with the app button (opens AppSwitcher in the sheet)
Rail row: icon, name, count, chevron
sub pages' and count, page bookmark toggle, Bookmarks link with count, Open page
Footer: focused tile name and description, 'You are here', key hints
props: pages: Page[] the user may open
page: index of the current rail row
focus: index of the focused tile
canSetup: boolean, the user may continue the app's setup
states: Section without sub pages: the page is its own tile (S02)
App with no pages: 'No pages yet' and Continue setup, the button only for users who may set it up (N10)
events: Rail row → shows its sub pages
Tile click → opens the page, closes the sheet, focus returns to Menu (N8, N9)
Open <page> → opens the page, closes the sheet
Bookmark toggle → adds or removes the bookmark at once
Click outside → closes the sheet, focus returns to Menu (N8)
Picking another app → loads its pages with a skeleton; Monitoring never shows loading (N6)
Arrow keys move focus between tiles; they never open (N9)
B toggles the bookmark of the focused tile, not while typing
Esc closes the sheet and returns focus to Menu; stop propagation so Grafana's own Esc does not also run (R08)
data: useApps (pages from the nav tree or app includes)
open: Tab order: rail first or tiles first (R08)
Group tab names: 'Access' or Grafana's 'Users and access' (R08, decision needed)

components.name: AppSwitcher
components.summary: List of enabled apps to choose the active app. One component in two places: above the dock workspace button and inside the MenuSheet rail.
parts: Pick one to see its pages'
App row: tile in the app accent, name, subtitle, 'New' on the most recently enabled app, check on the active app
Apps row: link to the Apps page (/apps)
props: apps: App[] enabled for the user
states: App with no pages ('No pages yet' subtitle)
events: App row → sets the active app (useActiveApp), closes the list
Click outside or Esc → closes, focus returns to the button that opened it
Up and Down move between rows
open: Limit of apps in the selector (R10)

components.name: UserMenu
components.summary: Profile menu under the avatar.
parts: Items: Profile, Notification history, Change password, Change theme, Enable kiosk mode, Latest from the blog
props: items: from the profile nav node
events: Item → navigates or runs its action, closes the menu
Click outside or Esc → closes, focus returns to the avatar
data: Profile nav node and kiosk toggle via upstream/
open: Items are the prototype's; Grafana builds them from the profile nav node (R09)

components.name: AddMenu
components.summary: Create actions under the Add button.
props: items: create actions from the nav tree
events: Item → navigates to the create page, closes the menu
Click outside or Esc → closes, focus returns to Add
data: Nav items with isCreateAction via upstream/
open: Items not compared with Grafana's QuickAdd (R09)

components.name: DockBookmarkAdd
components.summary: Popover of the dock '+' slot: the active app's pages as a tree with their sub pages and bookmark toggles, a search, and the dock capacity.
parts: Page tree: chevron, one indent level, one page open at a time
Bookmark toggle per page and sub page
events: Toggle → adds or removes the bookmark; it lands in the dock group at once
x, click outside or Esc → closes, focus returns to the slot
Typing goes to the search field
open: Bookmark limit per app is a proposal (R10)

components.name: OverlaySurface
components.summary: The glass surface and the open and close rules every overlay shares. Each overlay board drew the surface on its own; the rules were open on R09 and decided for the menu in N8.
parts: Glass surface: rgba(30,33,39,.62), blur 20, saturate 140%, radius 10, 1px top highlight
events: Opening another overlay → closes this one (one overlay at a time)
Closing → focus returns to the anchor
open: Focus trap, scroll lock, position near edges (R09, to define)
prefers-reduced-transparency (R09)

components.name: PageTile
components.summary: One sub page in the MenuSheet grid: icon tile, name, bookmark toggle.
props: current: boolean, the page on screen
events: Focus → becomes the focused tile, the footer shows its description

components.name: CardToggle
components.summary: The one bookmark toggle: on tiles, page cards, sub page rows, the popover tree and, with a label, in the MenuSheet header. Acts at once.
states: Bookmarked (filled; green on cards, accent on tiles)
events: Click → toggles the bookmark; never selects or opens the card

components.name: FilterTabs
components.summary: Segmented tabs with counts: All / Enabled / Needs action, All / Bookmarked / Available, and the MenuSheet group tabs.
events: role tablist: Left and Right move, Enter selects

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: The one badge box (22 high): lifecycle status chip, 'New', update chip, step pills.
props: tone: one of the seven colour groups
states: One per colour group: neutral, in progress, needs attention, setup, ready, enabled, failed

components.name: AppCard
components.summary: One app on the Apps page: identity, status icon, description, meta row, the buttons for its status.
parts: AppStatus icon at the top right (not a button)
Meta: page count, status name, update chip, In dock and In the menu icons

components.name: AppStatus
components.summary: The lifecycle status model and its icon: 13 statuses, 7 colour groups, the buttons and gates per status.
open: Exact labels, recovery actions (R10)

components.name: LifecycleActionButton
components.summary: Outline button for a lifecycle step, in the colour of its action type. Open, Manage and View progress stay neutral.
parts: Outline 30 high on a card, radius 6, label 14/22 500
events: Click → runs the step or opens its view

components.name: AppPreviewPanel
components.summary: Read-only panel of the selected app on the Apps page.

components.name: LifecycleStepper
components.summary: Vertical list of the six steps: done, current, locked.
open: @grafana/ui has no stepper (R10)

components.name: ChecksList
components.summary: Results of initialization checks, setup validation, health and page checks. R03 calls it ConfigCheck.
parts: Summary bar: counts, last run, Run check
Row: mark 20, title, detail, source, fix button
states: Not run or Not available (dashed ring)
events: Fix → opens the setup section that fixes it
open: How 'route responds' is tested (R02)

components.name: AppVersionInfo
components.summary: Version block: Installed, Latest, Needs Grafana, This Grafana, Last checked. Information only. R03 calls it AppUpdates.
data: Plugin info and catalog via upstream/

components.name: PageCard
components.summary: Compact page card on the bookmarks page with its sub page expander.
parts: Description and status icons (In dock, In the menu)
m bookmarked' with sub page rows

components.name: PagePanel
components.summary: Details and Edit bookmark of the selected page.
parts: Footer: Edit, or Reset to default, Cancel, Save
events: Save → stores dock, label, show name, icon, position

components.name: DockPreview
components.summary: What the dock will show, per app, from the same state as the cards.
parts: Group per app: accent dot, name, 'N in the dock'

components.name: AppsView
components.summary: The Apps page (/apps): every installed app plugin with its lifecycle status and the buttons for that status.
parts: Page header with Check for updates
events: Card → selects it, the preview shows it
Card button → runs or opens the lifecycle step (AppLifecycleView) or Manage (AppManageView)

components.name: AppLifecycleView
components.summary: One page per app (/apps/<id>/setup) that takes it from Not initialized to Enabled in six steps; also the edit mode of setup and the view after an update.
parts: Step content: Review (ChecksList), Setup (six sections), Validate, Enable, Migrate
states: Step Initialize, Review, Setup, Validate, Enable, Migrate
Edit mode: only Setup and Validate open
events: Accept and continue to setup → Setup
Enable → Enabled, migration starts when pending
open: Server-side gates (R10)

components.name: AppManageView
components.summary: Manage one enabled or disabled app (/apps/<id>): status and health, where it appears, pages, access, data sources, actions.
parts: Tabs: Overview, Pages, Access, Data sources, Health
Right panel: About, AppVersionInfo, Who can act
Actions: Open setup, Disable or Enable, Uninstall
events: Open setup → AppLifecycleView in edit mode
Disable, Enable, Uninstall → runs the operation
open: Who may disable or uninstall (R02)

components.name: DockPagesView
components.summary: The bookmarks page (/bookmarks): bookmark pages and sub pages of every app and decide what the dock shows.
parts: PageCard grid, 2 columns, under sticky app headers
open: Per user or per organisation (R10, decision needed)

components.name: useActiveApp
components.summary: The active app: set by the AppSwitcher, read by the dock, the sheet, the breadcrumb chip and the accent tokens.
states: Loading another app's pages (never for Monitoring, N6)
events: setApp(id) → every component that reads it updates

components.name: useBookmarks
components.summary: One bookmark store for every app, Monitoring included (N7). Every toggle reads and writes it, so the dock, sheet, popover and bookmarks page always agree.
props: returns { bookmarks, isBookmarked(url), toggle(url), details(url), save(url, details) }
events: toggle → written to navbar.bookmarkUrls and shown in the dock at once
data: user storage orbit-bookmarks for dock, label, show name, added, source
open: Per user or per organisation (R10)

components.name: useApps
components.summary: Apps with their pages, sub pages, accent and lifecycle status.
data: Nav tree and plugin.json includes via upstream/

components.name: useOverlay
components.summary: Which overlay is open, so only one is open at a time and focus can return to its trigger.
events: toggle(id) → opens id and closes any other
close() → focus returns to the anchor

components.name: AppManifest
components.summary: App fields the UI reads: name, description, version, logo, includes (pages and sub pages) and the new ui block (accent, show, page descriptions).
open: Where the ui block lives; self-tests and migrations contract (S13)

components.name: PageTemplate
components.summary: Layouts over Grafana's Page inside the shell: Standard, Dashboard, Settings and Admin, List, Detail with info panel; with the button zones and page states.
parts: Tabs when the page has children
open: Who owns the gutter inside the inner panel (P01, decision needed)
Dock clearance at the bottom (P01)
